# cargoship_cluster_facts (Data Source)

Reads what cargoship can learn about a fleet without changing it: each host's operating system, architecture, hostname, private address, and the engine version it is running. It runs the five read-only phases of an apply (`Connect`, `DetectOS`, `GatherFacts`, `GatherFactsDistro`, `Disconnect`), takes no cluster lock, and writes nothing to any host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cargoship_cluster_facts" "fleet" {
  name          = "fleet-facts"
  load_balancer = "10.0.0.10"
  distro        = "k3s"

  host {
    address  = "10.0.0.11"
    role     = "controller"
    key_path = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
  }
}

output "installed_versions" {
  value = { for n in data.cargoship_cluster_facts.fleet.nodes : n.hostname => n.engine_version }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `distro` (String) The engine to read: `k3s` or `rke2`. It is what tells cargoship which version string to look for on each host.
- `load_balancer` (String) The address clients use to reach the control plane. Nothing is contacted through it here -- the facts are read over SSH -- but the cluster document requires it.
- `name` (String) The cluster's name. It becomes `metadata.name` in the cluster document cargoship reads.

### Optional

- `host` (Block List) A host to read. Controllers are read first whatever order the blocks are in, because that is the order an apply uses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--host))

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (Attributes List) What was read back, one entry per host block, in the same order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedblock--host"></a>
### Nested Schema for `host`

Required:

- `address` (String) The address or hostname cargoship opens an SSH connection to.
- `role` (String) The host's role: one of `controller`, `controller+worker`, `single`, `worker`.

Optional:

- `hostname` (String) The name the host is known by before it has been visited.
- `key_path` (String) Path to the SSH private key on the machine running OpenTofu. There is no attribute for key material, and there will not be: a key in the configuration is a key in the state file.
- `port` (Number) The SSH port. Defaults to 22.
- `private_address` (String) Overrides the private address the facts phase would discover.
- `profile` (String) The profile this host selects from the cluster's profile map.
- `user` (String) The SSH user. Defaults to `root`.


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The address cargoship connected to.
- `arch` (String) The CPU architecture the host reports.
- `engine_version` (String) The engine version running on the host, or `v0.0.0` for a host with no engine installed. This is the value a plan-time downgrade check compares a package against.
- `hostname` (String) The hostname the host reports.
- `os` (String) The `ID` from the host's os-release.
- `os_version` (String) The `VERSION_ID` from the host's os-release.
- `private_address` (String) The private address cargoship discovered, or the one the host block declared.
- `role` (String) The role the host block gave it.
